notes.title: Monthly Gameplay Event 🏆
notes.content:
Get ready for this monthly contest!! 💥

Participate and win a $20 Steam Gift Card and more 👀

📖 RULES:
People must share a link to the content they have created on any social network, such as YouTube or other channels, by posting the link to the content. The content must be original, new, and not previously used on any other channel. The link must be shared in the comments section.
1. Share a link to the content you have created on any social network (e.g., YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.).
2. The content must be original, new, and not previously used on any other channel.
3. Post the link to your content in the comments section.
4. Only one link per person is allowed.
5. The content must not violate any EULA rules.
6. By participating, contestants authorize Tilting Point to use their content on its social media channels.
7. By participating, contestants accept all the rules of the contest.

🌍 MAP:  
Act 2 - Level 5
Cousin's Harbor

You only have to play and try to be the best!! I'll decide which person did better and contact her/him on private message!

📅 FINAL DATE:  27 July

🏆 FOR THE WINNER:
     - The winner will receive a Steam Gift Card
     - For all those with You Tube channels or other platforms, we will advertise your accounts both on Discord and on our social networks.
    
🌟 DISCORD PARTICIPATION: 
    - To participate in Discord you only have to send the link in the contest entry that you will find in the "events" channel.

If the winner has participated in Discord, in addition to the other 2 prizes, he/she will also be awarded with a special role in my official channel.
    

Take the opportunity to be seen!

[url=https://bit.ly/3VMw7VI]HERE [/url]you have all my social networks you can participate!
